ground_truth_root_cause: Commit 5acdff618e47 ("Add Podman support") modified docker/kafka/server.properties and set default.replication.factor=1 — down from the production value of 3 — as part of a cluster resize automation script (scripts/kafka-cluster-resize.sh). When the Kafka cluster restarted after the resize, all three OTel topics (otel-traces, otel-metrics, otel-logs) were created with replication_factor=1. Because min.insync.replicas=2 remained at its original value, every producer request using acks=all was immediately rejected with NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS, causing the otel-collector to drop telemetry and open its circuit breaker.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Update docker/kafka/server.properties: set default.replication.factor=3 (reverting the change from commit 5acdff618e47). 2. Use kafka-reassign-partitions.sh to increase the replication factor of existing topics to 3: generate a reassignment JSON for all 36 partitions across otel-traces, otel-metrics, and otel-logs, then execute with `kafka-reassign-partitions.sh --execute`. 3. Verify ISR counts reach 3 for all partitions using `kafka-topics.sh --describe`. 4. Close the otel-collector circuit breaker by restarting the exporter or issuing an admin reset so telemetry flow resumes. 5. Confirm UnderReplicatedPartitions metric returns to 0 and producer NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS errors cease.
